name: Obsidian
shortDescription: Local-first notes app. Official pricing says the app is free without limits; Sync and Publish are paid.
longDescription: Obsidian is a local-first notes app. The official pricing page says the app is free without limits and does not require a sign-up. Sync and Publish are paid add-ons ($4 and $8 per month billed annually on the page we read). Catalyst is a $25 one-time option, and a commercial license was listed at $50 per user per year. We did not install the app.
bestFor: Personal or team notes that live in local files
People who want the app itself without a subscription
notIdealFor: A multiplayer wiki with no local files
strength: The official pricing page says the app is free without limits and does not require a sign-up.
weakness: Sync and Publish are separate paid add-ons, so device sync and a public site are not included with the free app.
smokeTestNotes: No local install attempted (SaaS/desktop/extension or install not feasible without account).

useCaseFit.meetings-knowledge: Local-first notes app that the official pricing page says is free without limits.
